prose: The Wall Street Journal reports SpaceX's Q3 capital expenditure reached $19.6 billion, up from $6.9 billion a year earlier, with connectivity revenue (including Starlink) up 69% year over year to $5.2 billion and AI revenue surging around 830%. The article could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline figures.
highlights: Q3 capex: $19.6B, up from $6.9B a year earlier
Connectivity revenue (incl. Starlink) up 69% YoY to $5.2B
Source: Becky Peterson, WSJ, via Techmeme
